title: Code and predictions for: Detecting Synthetic Errors in Chest X-Ray Reports: A Patient-Disjoint Benchmark with Error-Free Controls
description: Code, configuration, result tables and prediction files for a patient-disjoint benchmark of report-level error detection on ReXErr-v1, in which every error-injected chest X-ray report is paired with its original report as an error-free control. Includes fine-tuned encoders, lexical baselines, locally run LLMs, prevalence-adjusted operating points, a cross-generator test and rewording controls. No report text is included; ReXErr-v1 is available from PhysioNet.
